description: FPM Historical Extent of Flooding (DWER-123) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. Historically, low-lying land adjacent to rivers and coastlines has been favoured for settlement as they provided sources of fresh water, food, transportation and waste disposal. These areas become affected by flooding during sufficiently heavy or prolonged rainfall, high tides or storm surges and cyclones. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. Its tags are Rivers Mapping, Rivers Monitoring, Rivers Research, Rivers Surveys, Water. It offers 8 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_active_acceptance. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
